# Prompt Suite 2.6.0

Prompt 2.6.0 is the workload-budget overlay on the frozen Prompt 2.4.0 curriculum contract and frozen Prompt 2.5.0 grounding overlay. The production bundle compiles the three layers in order.

This version introduces workload-aware planning, critic responsibility, bounded exceptions, and retry-targeted repair. Scheduled Work estimates fit while authoring; the Finisher remains the authoritative deterministic normalizer and release gate. Schema remains 2.3.0.
